headline: Bohm goes 5-for-5 as Phillies rout Twins 9-1
recap: The Phillies routed the Twins 9-1 at Target Field on Saturday, riding a five-hit night from Alec Bohm and a strong start from Jesus Luzardo. Minnesota starter Connor Prielipp (L, 3-6) was rocked for eight runs over five innings, with Philadelphia scoring once in the second and breaking the game open with a seven-run fifth. Bohm went 5-for-5 with three doubles and an RBI, Bryson Stott hit a three-run homer and drew two walks, and J.T. Realmuto and Edmundo Sosa each drove in two runs. Luzardo (W, 11-5) allowed one run over 6.2 innings with nine strikeouts, and Chase Shugart and Alex McFarlane closed out the final 2.1 innings without a run.
Philadelphia is 66-58, second in the NL East, 7.5 games behind the first-place Braves, and has won two straight.

The Phillies continue their series with the Twins Sunday at Target Field, with Andrew Painter set to start opposite Minnesota's Dean Kremer. First pitch is 2:10 PM ET. DraftKings lists the Phillies as -108 favorites on the moneyline.
